request.question: How often must third-party API keys be rotated, and what happens if a credential is exposed?

response.answer: Database credentials are rotated automatically every 30 days. [1] Third-party API keys must be rotated at least every 90 days. [1] Any credential that is suspected to be exposed must be revoked and rotated immediately, and the exposure must be reported to the Security Team within 1 hour. [1] This policy applies to all credentials, API keys, certificates, and tokens used by Orbitly services and engineers. [2]
